items.prompt: At 6 a.m. a mountain town is -3°C. By noon it is 11 degrees warmer. By evening it falls by 5 degrees. What is the evening temperature in °C?
hints: Do the two changes in order.
Then take away 5 from your answer.
Think of a thermometer going down below zero.
The further below zero, the colder.
Compare -7 and -2 on a number line.
items.explanation: -7°C is 7 degrees below zero, which is further below zero than -2°C. So it is coldest.

options.why: This is warmer than -7°C. It is closer to zero.
Zero is warmer than any negative temperature.
This is above zero, so it is the warmest.

items.prompt: A diver is at -12 m. She swims up 5 m, then down 9 m. What is her position now? Write it as a number.
hints: Up makes the number bigger. Down makes it smaller.
-7 take away 9 gives a number further below zero.
